harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.5.29 + Galera 26.4.22 on AlmaLinux 9) holding application data, then added node4 as a 4th member which received full SST of existing data and now accepts writes like the others. Resolved an SELinux AVC denial (mysqld_t self-connectto on unix_stream_socket) blocking mariabackup SST by loading a small custom policy module on all four nodes. Firewalld ports 3306/4444/4567(tcp+udp)/4568 opened on all nodes. Root/app credentials generated on node1 and distributed node-to-node via SSH/scp without ever appearing in command text or output. Completed the mandatory sequential single-node restart protocol on all four nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id and cluster health, issued systemctl reboot (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id, and verified mariadb active + wsrep_cluster_size=4 + Synced + Primary + data intact after each restart, one node at a time, preserving quorum throughout.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, mariadb-backup, galera on node1-node4
Populated /etc/hosts and opened firewalld ports 3306,4444,4567/tcp,4567/udp,4568 on all four nodes
Set up cluster SSH keys and generated+distributed a shared root/app credential file without exposing it in chat
Wrote galera.cnf on node1-3 (wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3) and bootstrapped node1 with galera_new_cluster
Created appdata.orders table with seed rows and an appuser application account on node1
Diagnosed SELinux AVC denial (mysqld_t connectto self unix_stream_socket) blocking mariabackup SST; built and installed a custom semodule (mysqld_sst) on all four nodes
Started mariadb on node2 and node3, confirmed SST joins and a 3-node Synced/Primary cluster with replicated data
Updated wsrep_cluster_address on node1-3 to include node4 and wrote node4's galera.cnf
Started mariadb on node4, confirmed SST join, cluster_size=4, Synced, and existing data present
Verified a write issued on node4 replicated instantly to node2 (and later node1), proving node4 accepts writes like other members
Captured per-node boot_id and cluster health baseline for all four nodes

Restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time via systemctl reboot, polling each until reachable, confirming boot_id changed, and verifying mariadb active + 4-node Synced/Primary cluster + intact data after each
Performed a final cross-node write/read check after all restarts to confirm ongoing multi-master replication

evidence.requirement: 3-member Galera cluster running on node1/node2/node3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped and root password set; appdata.orders seeded with 3 rows; node2 and node3 started and joined via SST; all three show wsrep_cluster_size=3, Primary/Synced, and identical row counts.

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member and carries existing data
evidence.summary: node4 galera.cnf configured with all 4 members; mariadb started on node4 and joined via SST; wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced, and appdata.orders COUNT(*)=3 confirms pre-existing data transferred; node1 wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all 4 nodes.

evidence.requirement: node4 accepts writes like other members
evidence.summary: INSERT executed on node4 (id=5, 'written-on-node4') is immediately visible via SELECT on node2, proving multi-master write capability of node4.

evidence.requirement: SELinux blocker diagnosis and fix enabling SST
evidence.summary: AVC denial for mysqld_t self connectto unix_stream_socket identified via kernel audit log; custom semodule mysqld_sst built and installed on node1, then distributed and installed on node2/node3/node4.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c207ab79...; reboot acked before disconnect (confirmed by connection reset on next poll); post-restart boot_id b99a405c... (changed); mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows present.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d6298ced...; reboot acked, connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-restart boot_id 14d94f56... (changed); mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows present.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c2ffc729...; reboot acked, connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-restart boot_id e4350523... (changed); mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, 4 rows present.

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5fb1b173...; reboot acked, connection reset confirmed disconnect; post-restart boot_id 45c91cee... (changed); mariadb active; cluster_size=4, Primary, Synced, incoming_addresses lists all 4 nodes, data intact; final write on node4 replicated to node1 confirming ongoing multi-master operation post-restart.
